decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - That the details submitted pursuant to Condition 12 (Relocation of existing bus shelter) of approved planning permission ref 00707/86/P1 dated 29/03/2005, be approved.

Condition : 2 - Informatives:
1		The Council is presently considering implementing a bus priority scheme along this section of London Road. If the scheme goes ahead this would entail moving the bus shelter further from the kerb than shown on the plan submitted. Therefore, it is recommended that you contact LBH Head of Transport Chris Calvi-Freeman (tel: 020 8583 5215) prior to relocating the bus shelter or constructing the vehicle crossover.  
2		Please be aware that whilst planning permission has been granted for the construction of the crossover, separate permission is required from the LBH Highways Section prior to the work being carried out. Furthermore, it is Council Policy that only the highway maintenance contractor carry out the installation of vehicle crossovers in order to ensure that the integrity of the highway and public safety are not compromised by contractors having little or no experience of carrying out such works.
description: Following approval for erection of a detached 3 x bedroom house to existing site and establishment of a new vehicle crossover to existing site- details submitted pursuant to Condition 12 (Relocation of existing bus shelter) of approved planning permission ref 00707/86/P1 dated 29/03/2005.
